attr.title: Mega Man W
attr.desc: Mega Man W is a fan made game by Team W which aims to be similar to the original six mega man games. You will face off against a fierce hoard of robots infected by a virus corrupting them and making them go mad!
attr.inst: Just Download the port or place the zip into the auto install folder. If you wish to use a updated version download it from https://jumpdashevade.itch.io/mega-man-w and place the .pck into the ports root directory.
